summary: Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, announcing the convening of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 30, 2026, at its registered office. The filing includes a press release, convening notice, and a board report on agenda items 23 and 24. No special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, restructuring) is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions. This is an ordinary annual meeting notice, not a special situation.
